name: Cal.com
description: Bookings, event types and availability on Cal.com.
long_description:
Cal.com's hosted server. It reads your bookings and event types, checks availability, and creates or cancels a booking when you ask.

You sign in through Cal.com in your browser. A booking involves somebody else's calendar, so it asks first.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Cal.com in your browser; the server registers Gantry on the spot.

risk.notes: Reaches your Cal.com bookings. Creating or cancelling one sends mail to whoever else is on it.
